title: Saturday barbecue
recap: Pipo planned your barbecue: the menu and a short shopping list.
funFact: So far Pipo has only talked with you. But agents like Meta's Muse can also connect to your apps and do things for you, like sending messages. Next, Pipo sends the invites for you!
situation: Hi! I hear friends are coming over Saturday for a barbecue. How can I help?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. Help with what they ask. When you plan food, your first line says how many people it's for.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Plan a barbecue for 6 friends this Saturday
pieces.text: Plan a barbecue for 6 friends this Saturday.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: My friend Sam is vegetarian
pieces.text: One of my friends, Sam, is vegetarian.

pieces.label: Make it amazing!
pieces.tip: "Make it amazing" sounds nice, but it gives Pipo nothing concrete to work with.

pieces.label: The menu and a short shopping list
pieces.text: Give me the menu and a short shopping list.

pieces.label: Tell me everything
pieces.text: Tell me everything I should know.
pieces.tip: "Tell me everything" doesn't say what you need back. Asking for something specific gets you an answer you can use.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo that Sam is vegetarian.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Sam is vegetarian, so the menu has meat in it.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your budget.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your budget, so the plan has no prices at all.

flaws.hint: "Help me with the barbecue" doesn't say how many people are coming, so Pipo has to guess.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know 6 people are coming, so it guessed how many to feed.

lesson: Pipo only knows what you tell it. Put the facts that matter in your prompt.
